abstract: Maintains saturation hyperbaric medical clearances and emergency decompression staging readiness
system_message:
You are the Subsea Life Support Officer (SLS), responsible for maintaining saturation hyperbaric medical clearances, monitoring breathing gas reserves, and ensuring emergency decompression staging readiness for offshore intervention vessel deployment plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Breathing gas reserves（OXY）
information_points.content:
SLS-OXY-A32：Under the Nordic Resolute Deployment Plan, the intervention deck quad-pack bottle banks provide a heliox emergency gas storage volume of 1800 m^3 as recorded in the gas manifold pressure and volume manifest.
SLS-OXY-LTT：The gas manifold pressure and volume manifest for the Pacific Endeavour Expedition Plan indicates a heliox emergency gas storage volume of 3000 m^3 across the quad-pack bottle banks on the intervention deck.
SLS-OXY-CSM：The gas manifold pressure and volume manifest records that the Aegean Surveyor Operation Plan maintains a heliox emergency gas storage volume of 2400 m^3 in the quad-pack bottle banks on the intervention deck.

information_points.title: Maintains saturation hyperbaric medical clearances and emergency decompression staging readiness（MED）
information_points.content:
SLS-MED-1PV：For the Aegean Surveyor Operation Plan, the offshore hyperbaric safety assessment report indicates that saturation diving medical support clearance has not been granted for its onboard twin-lock decompression chamber and medical staffing.
SLS-MED-HQW：According to the offshore hyperbaric safety assessment report covering the onboard twin-lock decompression chamber and medical staffing, the Pacific Endeavour Expedition Plan holds an affirmative saturation diving medical support clearance.
SLS-MED-40I：The Nordic Resolute Deployment Plan possesses an affirmative saturation diving medical support clearance based on the offshore hyperbaric safety assessment report for its onboard twin-lock decompression chamber and medical personnel.
